title: Differential compatibility of the fixed normalized decalage page isomorphisms.
statement: Let C be abelian and U a filtered cochain complex. For every r ≥ 2 and bidegrees i,j, the fixed normalized decalage page isomorphisms commute with the page differential.

lean.statement:
theorem filteredComplex_decalage_page_differential_coherence
    (U : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ)) :
    ∀ (r : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (i j : ℤ × ℤ),
    (filteredComplexDecalagePageIso U i.1 i.2 r hr).hom ≫
        ((((filteredComplexDecalageSpectralObjectFunctor C).obj U).E₂SpectralSequence).page
          r hr).d i j =
      (((filteredComplexCanonicalModel C).S.obj U).page r hr).d i j ≫
        (filteredComplexDecalagePageIso U j.1 j.2 r hr).hom

proof.text: Compare the spectral and canonical differential composites on unquotiented cycle representatives; the connecting-map and normalized representative equations identify them, and cancellation gives the result.
